content.title: Leaseholders in England and Wales to have ground rent capped in 2028
content.caption: The housing minister Matthew Pennycook introduces a bill to eventually ban virtually all new leasehold properties, including measures to cap charges, end the sale of new leasehold flats, and make it easier to extend and buy out leases.
